capabilities: append timestamped entries of type experiment, result, decision or idea with automatic git, parameter, data and figure provenance
run offline queries that write a project timeline, a side-by-side comparison of two runs, and a parameter search to a queries note
generate a weekly report through a local Ollama model with bullets that cite the entries they came from
export a reproducibility card with commit, repository URL, command, parameters, data hashes and figures
watch configured repository, data and figures folders to detect changed files and new images
extras: Part of the author's Companion suite of local-first plugins (Local Vault Agent, Lecture Companion, Paper Companion and others, all at github.com/TonyPeonio). Desktop-only because it shells out to git and hashes files; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Hashing covers only the first 64 MB of each data file.
problem: Researchers must manually record experimental provenance like commits, config parameters, data file versions and figures, and Obsidian has no structured lab-notebook tool for this.

relations.evidence: The plugin runs git and hashes files, so it is desktop only.
an optional weekly report uses a local model through Ollama

summary: Append-only lab notebook that logs experiments, results, decisions and ideas with git commit, parameters, data hashes and figures filled in, then queries them.
